# B.MILLS

B.MILLS is the professional website of Brian Mills, a New York City DJ and event sound director specializing in music direction, tailored sound curation, luxury brand activations, corporate events, private client events, and afterparties.

## Primary Pages

- [Homepage](https://djbmills.com/)
- [Brand Activations](https://djbmills.com/brand-activations)
- [Corporate Events](https://djbmills.com/corporate-events)
- [Corporate Events in New Jersey](https://djbmills.com/corporate-events-nj)
- [Afterparties](https://djbmills.com/afterparties)
- [Availability](https://djbmills.com/availability)

## Services

B.MILLS provides live DJ performance, music direction, sound curation, and event-focused music programming for luxury brands, corporate clients, private events, cultural events, and afterparties.

## Service Areas

Primary service areas include New York City, the Hamptons, Westchester County, New Jersey, Connecticut, South Florida, and travel destinations worldwide.
